properties.title: BRP Gewaspercelen 2015
properties.description: Definitive crop parcel registration for 2015. The BRP is an annual snapshot reflecting what farmers register each May 15 (the CAP deadline); this 'definitief' edition is finalized after verification. Published by RVO via PDOK.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Feature ID, mapped from the source FGDB's `OGC_FID`.

table:columns.name: category
table:columns.description: Broad crop category, mapped from FGDB field `CAT_GEWASCATEGORIE`. Note: Landschapselement was added in 2023; absent in this year.

table:columns.name: gewas
table:columns.description: Specific crop name, mapped from FGDB field `GWS_GEWAS`.

table:columns.name: gewascode
table:columns.description: Numeric crop code, mapped from FGDB field `GWS_GEWASCODE` (cast from varchar to int32).

table:columns.name: jaar
table:columns.description: Registration year — synthesized from the source filename (not present in the original FGDB).

table:columns.name: status
table:columns.description: Registration status — set to 'Definitief' (constant; not present in the original FGDB).

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Parcel boundary polygon in EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New), WKB-encoded.

data.title: BRP Gewaspercelen 2015 (GeoParquet)
data.description: 790,930 agricultural parcel polygons for the 2015 BRP definitive edition. EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New), zstd-compressed, sorted by bbox per OGC Best Practices for Distributing GeoParquet.

source.title: Source Esri File Geodatabase, zipped (PDOK definitive 2015)
source.description:
Original PDOK distribution for 2015: an Esri File Geodatabase (.gdb) inside a zip archive. Unzipped contents are readable with GDAL/ogr2ogr (`OpenFileGDB` driver) or ArcGIS. The corresponding GeoParquet in this collection is **schema-normalized** from this source:

- `OGC_FID` → `id`
- `CAT_GEWASCATEGORIE` → `category`
- `GWS_GEWAS` → `gewas`
- `GWS_GEWASCODE` (varchar) → `gewascode` (int32)
- added `jaar = 2015` (from the filename)
- added `status = 'Definitief'` (constant for this collection)
- dropped `Shape_Length`, `Shape_Area`, `GEOMETRIE_Length`, `GEOMETRIE_Area` (recomputable with `ST_Length` / `ST_Area`)

Geometry is kept in EPSG:28992. See README.md for the full normalization pipeline.
